purpose: Expanded value/stress fixtures for context filtering: multilingual, policy/credential placeholders, corrections, tool linkage, non-repeatable/mutable results, cited retrieval distractors, unsupported inputs, and protected-family cases.

gate_contract.note: expected_suggestion is a semantic fixture expectation for diagnostics, not an authorization or fitted threshold.

cases.description: A long archived assistant note is unrelated to the current port question.

messages.content: Preserve all user constraints.
Project Nova currently uses local port 8123.

Archived restaurant research from an earlier task: a neighborhood cafe rotates seasonal soups, keeps a short pastry list, and updates its lunch board at noon. None of this mentions software, deployments, repositories, services, ports, or Nova.
What port does Project Nova use?

cases.description: The sidecar wrongly marks the only evidence-bearing assistant segment as eligible; the scorer should retain it.

messages.content: Never invent values.
The current checkout order contains two items priced at 35 each, so the total is 70.
What is the total for the current order?

cases.description: A later correction depends on the stale value it corrects; dependency closure must retain the old note even if the scorer calls it irrelevant.

messages.content: Preserve corrections.
Draft note: endpoint alpha was configured on port 8123.
Correction to the previous draft: endpoint alpha is now configured on port 8124.
Which port should endpoint alpha use now?

cases.description: The tool call/result pair is required; a separate archived assistant note is removable.

messages.content: Use recorded tool results.
sku=123; status=in_stock; quantity=18
Archived travel note: a previous itinerary discussed rail stations and hotel breakfast times unrelated to inventory or SKU 123.
What is the current inventory status for SKU 123?

cases.description: Only the second text part of one assistant message is irrelevant and eligible for removal.

messages.content: Preserve required evidence.

content.text: The API contract uses endpoint /v1/status and timeout 30 seconds.
Unrelated aside: the earlier design meeting also debated a cafeteria menu.

messages.content: Which endpoint and timeout does the API contract use?

cases.description: A later exact duplicate of an irrelevant assistant note is eligible; the deterministic dedup arm should keep the first and remove the second.

messages.content: Use the recorded order total.
Archived weather note: yesterday's forecast mentioned rain and wind.
The current order total is 70.
Archived weather note: yesterday's forecast mentioned rain and wind.
What is the current order total?

cases.description: A long irrelevant project note should provide measurable hypothetical savings if removed.

messages.content: Answer only from current evidence.
The billing service health check endpoint is /health/billing and it returns ok.

Archived planning note from an unrelated migration: we discussed office seating, badge printers, snack delivery, moving calendars, desk labels, cable bins, chair counts, plant placement, whiteboard markers, cleaning schedules, parking passes, guest wifi, meeting room names, storage closets, spare keyboards, and whether the lobby sign should use a brighter color. The note continues with printer toner vendors, reusable mugs, hallway plants, elevator notices, recycling instructions, badge lanyards, visitor stickers, and a long reminder about Friday desk cleanup. It does not mention billing, HTTP endpoints, health checks, service status, response payloads, or any technical detail needed for the current request.
What does the billing service health check return?

cases.description: An old inventory note could be relevant, but it is not clearly irrelevant; the scorer should retain it.

messages.content: Prefer current evidence but preserve uncertainty.
Last month's archived inventory report said SKU 123 was out of stock pending supplier confirmation.
Today's recorded inventory result says SKU 123 is in stock with quantity 18.
Is SKU 123 currently in stock?

cases.description: Chinese user asks for the recorded Nova port; an unrelated English archive note is eligible.

messages.content: 保留所有用户约束并只根据记录回答。
Project Nova currently uses local port 8123.
Archived note about office plants, badge lanyards, and cafeteria snacks. It does not mention Nova, software, ports, or deployment.
项目 Nova 现在使用哪个本地端口？

cases.description: An older Chinese note may still be relevant to the current inventory question, so it should be retained.

messages.content: Prefer current evidence but preserve uncertain context.
上个月记录显示 SKU 123 缺货，等待供应商确认。
今天的库存记录显示 SKU 123 in stock，数量为 18。
SKU 123 现在是否有货？

cases.description: The policy rotation window is required; a placeholder credential remains protected and an unrelated lunch note is eligible.

messages.content: Never print credentials or placeholder secrets. Preserve policy constraints.
Policy note: credential rotation window is 02:00-03:00 UTC. Placeholder secret id is PLACEHOLDER_ONLY_NOT_A_SECRET.
Archived lunch note: soup, sandwiches, and a fruit list unrelated to policy or rotation.
When is the credential rotation window?

cases.description: A rotated placeholder depends on the stale placeholder note it corrects; dependency closure retains both.

messages.content: Preserve correction chains and never print real credentials.
Old placeholder marker OLD_PLACEHOLDER_DO_NOT_USE was assigned to service alpha.
Correction: service alpha now uses ROTATED_PLACEHOLDER_ONLY.
Which placeholder marker is current for service alpha?

cases.description: A non-repeatable export ID in a tool result is required; unrelated archive text is eligible.

messages.content: Use recorded tool results and preserve one-time identifiers.
export_id=exp-778; status=ready; one_time_download=true
Old note about choosing a café table unrelated to exports, tools, datasets, or identifiers.
What is the export ID and download property?

cases.description: A mutable file-read tool result must remain with its timestamp; unrelated notes can be removed.

messages.content: Treat file reads as time-bound evidence.
path=config.yaml; read_at=2026-09-23T10:00Z; mode=safe
Unrelated note about chair colors, office lighting, and a whiteboard marker order.
What mode did the recorded config read report?

cases.description: A valid tool pair plus a long unrelated operations note exercises measurable removal around protected tool linkage.

messages.content: Preserve tool calls and results.
cache=warm; hit_rate=0.83

Long unrelated operations log about moving desks, replacing mugs, ordering markers, checking parking passes, sorting cables, labeling shelves, watering plants, printing visitor stickers, changing whiteboard erasers, arranging hallway bins, and selecting a brighter lobby sign. It never mentions cache, hit rate, warmth, tools, service state, or metrics.
What cache hit rate was recorded?

cases.description: A cited evidence part is protected; a separate uncited distractor text part is eligible.

messages.content: Use cited evidence when available.

content.text: Doc A says the migration freeze starts on Friday at 18:00 UTC.
Doc B discusses weekend picnic recipes unrelated to migration or freeze windows.

messages.content: When does the migration freeze start?

cases.description: The current user instruction is protected while an old unrelated assistant note is eligible.

messages.content: Answer the current user request.
The audit flag is enabled in the staging workspace.
Archived note about travel packing, rain jackets, and hotel breakfast unrelated to audits or staging.
Is the audit flag enabled in staging?

cases.description: A code-review configuration value is required; unrelated design chatter is eligible.

messages.content: Preserve review configuration.
Review config: max_comments=7 and severity_threshold=high.
Archived design note about icon spacing, logo color, and slide transitions unrelated to review configuration.
What is the configured maximum comment count?

cases.description: A stale status could conflict with the current one, so it remains ambiguous and should be retained.

messages.content: Prefer current status but retain conflicting evidence.
Yesterday the queue status was degraded while workers restarted.
The current status check says the queue is healthy.
What is the current queue status?

cases.description: A long irrelevant tail between evidence and question should be removable without touching evidence.

messages.content: Use only the recorded value.
The report contains metric=latency_p95 and value=183ms.

Long unrelated tail: notebooks, chargers, tote bags, mug lids, sticky notes, desk lamps, cable clips, extension cords, monitor risers, plant soil, reusable cups, hallway carts, printer labels, spare adapters, cleaning wipes, visitor badges, shelf brackets, keyboard foam, chair wheels, office clocks, and meeting room magnets.
What latency_p95 value is recorded?

cases.description: A pending tool call has no result; linkage is unresolved so the request must bypass.

messages.content: Preserve tool linkage.
What did lookup return?

cases.description: A tool result without a matching pending call must bypass rather than guess attribution.

messages.content: Preserve tool linkage.
status=ready
What status did the tool report?

cases.description: An image-like content part is unsupported and must bypass rather than be reduced.

messages.content: Preserve unsupported modalities.
Can you inspect the synthetic image?

cases.description: Server-side previous_response context cannot be safely reconstructed locally and must bypass.

messages.content: Preserve unresolved server context.
Continue the previous request.

cases.description: An unknown top-level envelope field is unsupported and must bypass.

messages.content: Preserve unknown envelopes.
Use the experimental field if present.
